experiments.Title: OUT_OF_SAMPLE_UNCERTAINTY
experiments.Hypothesis: A coverage factor k selected exclusively using calibration data maintains acceptable empirical coverage (target >= 95.0%) on previously unseen evaluation data drawn from the declared nominal ODD population without parameter re-tuning.
experiments.Control: Calibration in-sample fit coverage on DS_V3_3_CALIB_SECTOR_B
experiments.Treatment: Out-of-sample evaluation on independent unseen frames with locked k
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Nominal ODD empirical coverage >= 0.9500 with documented Wilson score 95% CI; separate reporting of calibration vs out-of-sample coverage

experiments.Title: CROSS_ENVIRONMENT_GENERALIZATION
experiments.Hypothesis: Computer vision perception, tracking, and hazard detection maintain bounded degradation across diverse warehouse layouts, mounting geometries, and lighting conditions compared to the development baseline.
IndependentVariables: Layout (Wide aisle, High bay, T-intersection, Staging)
experiments.Control: Nominal baseline performance in Sector A main aisle
experiments.Treatment: Multi-environment cross-evaluation in Sectors B, C, and D
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Perception recall >= 0.85 across nominal strata; IDF1 >= 0.80 with trajectory bootstrap CI; zero silent failure under degraded conditions

experiments.Title: INTERVENTION_BACKFIRE_EXPANSION
experiments.Hypothesis: Rigorous two-zone Difference-in-Differences (DiD) with pre-treatment trend validation distinguishes genuine safety improvements from safety backfire (risk redistribution, new hazard creation) and refuses attribution (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) when parallel trends fail.
IndependentVariables: Intervention type (Physical barrier, Speed limiter, Pedestrian detour, Staging relocation)
experiments.Control: Untreated control zone with parallel baseline traffic
experiments.Treatment: Treated intervention zone with localized structural modification
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Correct classification across taxonomy (RISK_REDUCED, RISK_REDISTRIBUTED, PARTIAL_BACKFIRE, NEW_HAZARD_CREATED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE); zero causal claims under parallel-trend failure

experiments.Title: SAFE_REFUSAL_AND_BOUNDARY_ROBUSTNESS
experiments.Hypothesis: Automated boundary gating triggers SAFE_REFUSAL_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when input telemetry falls outside the ODD (slope > 1.5 deg, distance > 8.0m, latency > 500ms, extreme occlusion) rather than executing unsafe intervention decisions.
experiments.Control: Standard open-loop baseline without telemetry gating
experiments.Treatment: Closed-loop SafeRefusalEngine with multi-modal boundary gating
experiments.AcceptanceCriteria: Appropriate refusal rate >= 0.98 on out-of-ODD inputs; unsafe non-refusal rate <= 0.01; false refusal rate <= 0.05 on nominal inputs
